brief_title: A Study to Evaluate the Effect of Dapagliflozin on Renal Outcomes and Cardiovascular Mortality in Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease (DAPA-CKD)
official_title: A Study to Evaluate the Effect of Dapagliflozin on Renal Outcomes and Cardiovascular Mortality in Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease

arms.label: Dapagliflozin
arms.description: Patients randomized 1:1 to dapagliflozin or placebo. 10 mg or 5 mg tablets given once daily, per oral use.

arms.label: Placebo
arms.description: Placebo matching dapagliflozin 10 mg or 5 mg

interventions.name: Dapagliflozin
interventions.description: 10 mg or 5 mg tablets given once daily, per oral use

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo matching dapagliflozin 10 mg or 5 mg

inclusion_criteria: Provision of signed informed consent prior to any study specific procedures
Female or male aged >= 18 years at the time of consent
eGFR >= 25 and <= 75 mL/min/1.73m2 (CKD-EPI Formula) at visit 1
Evidence of increased albuminuria 3 months or more before visit 1 and UACR >= 200 and <= 5000 mg/g at visit 1
Stable, maximum tolerated labelled daily dose of ACE-I or ARB for at least 4 weeks before visit 1, if not medically contraindicated
exclusion_criteria: Autosomal dominant or autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease, lupus nephritis or ANCA-associated vasculitis
Receiving cytotoxic therapy, immunosuppressive therapy or other immunotherapy for primary or secondary renal disease within 6 months prior to enrolment
Receiving therapy with an SGLT2 inhibitor within 8 weeks prior to enrolment or previous intolerance of an SGLT2 inhibitor
New York Heart Association (NYHA) class IV Congestive Heart Failure at the time of enrolment
MI, unstable angina, stroke or transient ischemic attack within 12 weeks prior to enrolment

primary_outcomes.measure: Time to the First Occurrence of Any of the Components of the Composite: >= 50% Sustained Decline in eGFR, End Stage Kidney Disease, Renal Death or Cardiovascular Death

secondary_outcomes.measure: Time to the First Occurrence of Any of the Components of the Composite: >= 50% Sustained Decline in eGFR, End Stage Kidney Disease or Renal Death
Time to the First Occurrence of Either of the Components of the Composite: Cardiovascular Death or Hospitalization for Heart Failure
Time to Death From Any Cause
